sloka: आर्येण मम मान्धात्रा व्यसनम् घोरम् ईप्सितम् ।श्रमणेन कृते पापे यथा पापम् कृतम् त्वया ॥४-१८-३३॥
transliteration: āryeṇa mama māndhātrā vyasanam ghoram īpsitam ।śramaṇena kṛte pāpe yathā pāpam kṛtam tvayā ॥4-18-33॥

translations.english: A thief is freed from his theft either by punishment or by being let off; but a king who fails to punish a sinner himself incurs that sin.
